INSERT INTO
  closure (relation, ancestor, descendant, depth)
SELECT
  ?1,
  above.ancestor,
  below.descendant,
  above.depth + below.depth + 1
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      ?2 AS ancestor,
      0 AS depth
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      ancestor,
      depth
    FROM
      closure
    WHERE
      relation = ?1
      AND descendant = ?2
  ) AS above,
  (
    SELECT
      ?3 AS descendant,
      0 AS depth
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      descendant,
      depth
    FROM
      closure
    WHERE
      relation = ?1
      AND ancestor = ?3
  ) AS below
WHERE
  true
ON CONFLICT
  (relation, ancestor, descendant)
DO UPDATE SET
  depth = excluded.depth
WHERE
  excluded.depth < closure.depth
